newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: Macedonia, Germany sign military agreement.
newsitem.headline: Macedonia, Germany sign military agreement.

text.p: Macedonia and Germany signed on Tuesday an agreement on military cooperation that means German help in training Macedonian military officers and technical help for its army as part of Skopje's efforts to join NATO.
Defence Minister Blagoja Handziski said "the agreement comes at a significant period of intensive German-Macedonian cooperation at all levels".
German Defence Minister Volker Ruehe praised the success in the last five years of the Macedonian army, which started practically from nothing.
"It is important for Macedonia to stay stable not only for the country itself but for the whole region," Ruehe said.
